from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

num_qubits = 4
num_clbits = 4

qc = QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, num_clbits)

# Step 1: Apply H gate to all qubits 0, 1, 2, 3
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

# Step 2: Apply Rz(2.8507) to qubit 0, Rz(0.2836) to qubit 1, Rz(2.7925) to qubit 2, Rz(2.7328) to qubit 3
qc.rz(2.8507, 0)
qc.rz(0.2836, 1)
qc.rz(2.7925, 2)
qc.rz(2.7328, 3)

# Step 3: Apply CNOT(0,1), then Rz(1.6627) to qubit 1, then CNOT(0,1)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(1.6627, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

# Step 4: Apply CNOT(1,2), then Rz(1.9952) to qubit 2, then CNOT(1,2)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.rz(1.9952, 2)
qc.cx(1, 2)

# Step 5: Apply CNOT(2,3), then Rz(0.2854) to qubit 3, then CNOT(2,3)
qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.rz(0.2854, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Step 6: Repeat Steps 1-5 exactly once more (second ZZ layer)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

qc.rz(2.8507, 0)
qc.rz(0.2836, 1)
qc.rz(2.7925, 2)
qc.rz(2.7328, 3)

qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(1.6627, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.rz(1.9952, 2)
qc.cx(1, 2)

qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.rz(0.2854, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Step 7: Measure qubits 0,1,2,3 using qc.measure([0,1,2,3],[0,1,2,3])
qc.measure([0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 1, 2, 3])
